El fútbol está de luto, nadie está preparado para asumir que pueden pasar estas fatalidades sobre un terreno de juego. Descansa en paz, goleador. En cuanto al partido, no seré muy original diciendo que el Barça ya ha olvidado las derrotas ante el PSG y el Real Madrid. Si el 6-1 al Alavés no despejaba del todo las dudas por el planteamiento del rival, la victoria clara por 3-0 ante un Aston Villa duro de roer sí que pasa el corte y los de Flick vuelven a demostrar la superioridad exhibida en el inicio de la temporada.

articles.title: GTA 6 Install Size and Global Preload Times Confirmed - IGN Daily Fix - IGN
articles.summary: In today's Daily Fix:Rockstar has officially revealed how much space you'll need to clear for GTA 6, and it's about 212GB (Depending on your device, meaning PS5 and Xbox versions will likely have different sizes). The game will also be available for preload at 9pm PST on November 9th, and will be playable 9pm PST November 18th. For those missing the map that came with physical copies of the previous games, Rockstar will make a printable map available from their website, and a physical one you can buy for 99 cents (or free with a purchase of anything else). In other news, The Elder Scrolls 6 has officially received the subtitle of Sentinel, verifiying all those leaks from earlier. Bethesda has not fully revealed the game, but did confirm it will take place in the province of Hammerfell. And we’re riding Mine Cart Madness inside Super Nintendo World with The Ride Guys at Universal Epic Universe at Universal Orlando Resort.Presented by Universal Orlando Resort and its newest theme park, Universal Epic Universe.
